title: 節分の飾り枠
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Japanese ink-and-colour style Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 鬼の面・豆まきの升・柊鰯・恵方巻などで縁取った、節分の飾り枠12点の素材です。案内状やおたよりの囲みに使えます。
